topic: Puget Sound (King, Snohomish, Pierce; Bellevue/Kirkland/Redmond/Seattle Eastside) as baseline growth market for Integra Dental Design — dentist supply, named implant/digital practices, local labs and milling centers, DSOs, pricing/turnaround norms, study-club channels, switching barriers (desk research, accessed 2026-10-12)
summary:
Bottom line: the three-county Puget Sound market is large, dense in dentists, and already served by roughly 30 named independent labs in King County alone plus national mail-order labs, DSO in-house labs, and full-arch chains with on-site labs. There is no evidence it is underserved. Integra's realistic edge is proximity to a Bel-Red corridor cluster of prosthodontists, in-house 5-axis milling including titanium, and published flat pricing — not scarcity of competitors.

FACTS (primary sources). Washington had 7,071 dentist licenses in 2024 (UW CHWS using DOH licensure). King County's ratio was 112 licensed dentists per 100,000 (2023; 110 in the 2022 ACH brief), versus under 70 everywhere else in the state; Elevate Health (Pierce) was 55 and North Sound ACH (Snohomish plus four counties) 62 per 100,000 in 2022. DOH's 2023 legislative report puts King at ~1,000 patients per provider and Pierce at ~1,600. OFM April 1, 2025 populations: King 2,411,700; Pierce 959,900; Snohomish 873,800. Society memberships: SKCDS "over 1,600" dentists (WSDA takes over SKCDS management Sept 24, 2026; contact skcds@wsda.org); Snohomish County Dental Society "over 380"; Pierce County Dental Society "over 385" (~55% of Pierce dentists). Nationally, 21.2% of active dentists are specialists (ADA HPI 2025), so ~79% are GPs.

ESTIMATES. Applying the UW ratio to OFM population gives ~2,630 dentist license addresses in King County (2023) and ~2,700 at 2025 population; Pierce ~530–600 (license-based) or ~540–700 (society-implied); Snohomish ~540 (if it matches the North Sound ACH average) to ~690 (society-implied). Three-county total ~3,700–4,000 licenses, of which ~2,900–3,150 are GPs. Caveat from the source: license mailing address is not practice location and includes non-practicing dentists.

LABS. Desk research identified ~29 named labs in King County (Nakanishi, Protea, PNW Pros, Prime, Denny, New Era, Novus, Smile Design, Skylab, Shama, Seattle Dental Arts, Swiss Dental, Thorn Ford, First Impressions/Dentcron, Cox, New Smile, Paragon, Choice, Emerald, VTA-Renton, United, Ray Dental Studio, Cosmetic Dental Arts, Athena, Oral Esthetics, Tom Cummings, ProWest, Issaquah Dental Lab, Integra), 4+ in Snohomish (Seabrook, Oasis, Trosvig, Edgewood) and at least two in Pierce (University Park, Tacoma Dental Laboratories), plus Ziemek (Olympia) with its own milling center. That is roughly one identified lab per ~90 King County dentists — a floor, since the DOH Dental Laboratory Registration database could not be queried and the Census CBP API requires a key. No national-baseline comparison could be sourced, so "underserved" is not supportable. Only Integra publishes a public fee schedule locally; every other local lab quotes privately. National labs reach the area by mail (Glidewell: $9 FedEx each way or free USPS 2–4 days each way; Pro-Craft of Murrieta CA sells WA dentists a "free iTero" program with 3–5 day turnaround; Dandy has a Kirkland testimonial). NDX lists no WA lab; Issaquah Dental Laboratory (founded 1973) shows as acquired/PE-backed and its NDX page now redirects, so its status is unknown.

DSOs. PDS: 40 WA offices (Becker's, ~2023) running CEREC same-day crowns in-office. Willamette Dental Group: in-house lab (milled crowns, printed dentures) with WA offices in Bellevue, Everett, Kent, Mountlake Terrace, Puyallup, Seattle, Tacoma and 11 other cities. Light Dental Studios: 30 Puget Sound offices with an in-house denture lab. Gentle Dental 27 WA offices; Bright Now ~19. ClearChoice Metro-Seattle (Bellevue) and Nuvia Bellevue each run on-site labs and capture full-arch volume. Affordable Dentures has on-site denture labs in Tacoma and Lynnwood.

PRICING/TURNAROUND BENCHMARKS (published, mostly out-of-area): monolithic zirconia $89–$122 (Crown World, ROE, TrueGuide), lab-to-lab zirconia $39–$59 (Mabel), screw-retained zirconia implant crowns $299–$349, full-arch zirconia finals $1,999–$2,420. Integra's $129 crown is at the upper edge of national mail-order pricing, its $22 mill-only is well below lab-to-lab norms, and its $1,700 arch is competitive. Turnaround parity is 5–7 business days; local labs differentiate on free courier pickup/delivery (Oasis, Choice, Seabrook, CBI).

CHANNELS. SKCDS/SCDS/PCDS general meetings (PCDS sells sponsorships; Nakanishi sponsored April 2026), WSDA's PNDC (May 28–30, 2026, Seattle Convention Center, ~150 exhibitors), Seattle Study Club HQ in Kirkland with WA affiliates (Seattle Digital Dental Hub, ISGNW), Kois Center and four local Kois study groups (incl. Protea's in Redmond), Seattle Implant Study Club (Lynnwood, AAID-affiliated), 47 North Oral Surgery's restorative-implant mini-residency, Puget Sound Perio's South Sound study club, Washington AGD (SeaTac), WSDLA (board includes Protea's Leon Hermanides), and UW Graduate Prosthodontics (Interim Director Dr. John Sorensen, fully digital All-on-4 research lab; residents print models).

SWITCHING BARRIERS. Decades-long lab loyalty is documented in local testimonials; in-office milling is spreading (PDS, Bellevue Premier Dental, Sunrise Redmond, Lynnwood Dental Excellence); national labs subsidize scanners; full-arch chains and DSOs are vertically integrated. A dentist would try Integra for proximity (Drs. Najafi and Libman and two labs sit within ~1 mile), titanium milling, transparent pricing and owner access — not because alternatives are missing. Integra's concentration risk (2 clients = 91%) and thin cash are credibility issues a skeptical buyer will probe.

findings.claim: Washington had 7,071 dentist licenses in 2024 (DENT, DEFC, DERE, DEUW), up from 6,886 in 2022
findings.detail: UW Center for Health Workforce Studies, Washington Oral Health Workforce tracking page, using DOH licensure data as of December each year; 2022 breakdown: DENT 6,815, DEFC 17, DERE 23, DEUW 31. Funding for the tracking program ended 12/31/2025, page archived.

findings.claim: King County (Healthier Here ACH) had 112 licensed dentists per 100,000 population in 2023; all other ACHs were below 70
findings.detail: Same UW CHWS page; ratio is based on license mailing address with a Washington address, which the source says may not reflect practice status or location. The Nov 2024 UW data brief shows 110 per 100,000 for Healthier Here in its 2022 chart while its text says 130 — an internal inconsistency in the source.

findings.claim: Pierce County (Elevate Health ACH) had 55 and North Sound ACH (Snohomish, Skagit, Whatcom, Island, San Juan) 62 licensed dentists per 100,000 in 2022
findings.detail: UW CHWS Data Brief 'Dentist Distribution and Population Dental Need in Washington, 2022' (Nov 2024). Choice ACH lowest at 49. Snohomish-only figure is not published in the brief.

findings.claim: DOH reports ~74 dentists per 100,000 statewide, with King County at ~1,000 patients per provider and Pierce at ~1,600
findings.detail: Washington DOH Oral Health Equity Assessment, Report to the Legislature, Sept 2023. 1,000 patients/provider equals ~100 dentists per 100,000; 1,600 equals ~62.5 per 100,000.

findings.claim: OFM April 1, 2025 county populations: King 2,411,700; Pierce 959,900; Snohomish 873,800 (King 2023: 2,347,800)
findings.detail: Office of Financial Management April 1, 2025 official estimates (press release Table 1 and city/county allocation table). Bellevue 158,000; Kirkland 97,850; Redmond 82,380; Seattle 816,600; Issaquah 41,560 (2025).

findings.claim: Estimated licensed dentists: King ~2,630 (2023) to ~2,700 (2025); Pierce ~530–700; Snohomish ~540–690; three-county ~3,700–4,000, of which ~2,900–3,150 are general dentists
findings.detail: Estimate = UW per-100k ratio x OFM population (King 112 x 23.478 = 2,630; Pierce 55–63 x 9.599 = 528–605; Snohomish 62 x 8.738 = 542 if it matches the North Sound ACH average). Society-implied upper bounds: PCDS 385 members = ~55% of Pierce dentists implies ~700; SCDS 380 members at a similar 55–60% share implies ~630–690. GP share uses ADA HPI 2025 national figure of 21.2% specialists (~79% GP). License address is not practice location; includes non-practicing licensees.

findings.claim: ADA HPI: 205,088 professionally active U.S. dentists in 2025, 60.0 per 100,000, 21.2% in an ADA-recognized specialty
findings.detail: ADA Health Policy Institute dentist workforce page. King County's 110–112 per 100,000 is roughly 1.8x the national ratio — the county is dentist-dense, not dentist-scarce.

findings.claim: Seattle-King County Dental Society has 'over 1,600' member dentists; WSDA will provide its association management from Sept 24, 2026
findings.detail: SKCDS homepage. President Dr. April Dennison; questions to skcds@wsda.org; President-Elect nominations due Oct 23, 2026; General Membership Meetings held (September GMM referenced). Third-party profiles say 'almost 1,700'.

findings.claim: Snohomish County Dental Society has over 380 members; Pierce County Dental Society over 385 members (~55% of Pierce dentists)
findings.detail: SCDS homepage (Executive Director Sandra Anderson, info@scdentists.org). PCDS About Us page; PCDS LinkedIn gives 'over 430 members, ~80%' — conflicting and undated. PCDS GMMs at Tacoma Country & Golf Club with corporate sponsors; Nakanishi Dental Laboratory and Nobel Biocare sponsored the April 21, 2026 GMM; Executive Director Cindy Stephen, cindy@pcdentists.org.

findings.claim: At least 29 named dental labs operate in King County, ~4 in Snohomish and ~2 in Pierce, i.e., roughly one identified lab per ~90 King County dentists (a floor)
findings.detail: Compiled from lab websites and the Enigma WA dental-laboratory directory: Bellevue — Nakanishi (2959 Northup Way), PNW Pros (1726 138th Pl NE), Prime (14595 Bel-Red Rd), Denny Dental Lab (14420 NE Bel-Red Rd), New Era (1551 116th Ave NE), Integra; Redmond — Protea (15955 NE 85th St #204), Smile Design (2045 152nd Ave NE), Novus (425-867-5000); Kirkland — Skylab, Paragon Dental Arts; Issaquah — Issaquah Dental Laboratory (640 NW Gilman); Bothell — First Impressions/Dentcron, Cox, Thorn Ford; Kenmore — New Smile; Seattle — Shama, Seattle Dental Arts, Swiss Dental, Oral Esthetics, Tom Cummings, ProWest; Tukwila — United; Renton — Choice, Emerald, VTA office, Paragon; Kent — Ray Dental Studio; Maple Valley — Cosmetic Dental Arts; Auburn — Athena. Snohomish: Seabrook & Oasis (Lynnwood), Trosvig (Everett), Edgewood (Mukilteo). Pierce: University Park Dental Lab (University Place), Tacoma Dental Laboratories. Thurston: Ziemek (Olympia), Pacific Dental Arts (Olympia). The DOH registry (definitive count) could not be queried; no national baseline (Census CBP NAICS 339116) could be fetched, so no 'underserved' claim is made.
findings.value: ~29 King County labs identified; ~1 per 90 dentists (floor)

findings.claim: Nakanishi Dental Laboratory (Bellevue, 2959 Northup Way) is a full-service lab with 'many Certified Dental Technicians', ships nationwide, and sponsors county dental-society meetings
findings.detail: Company site: crowns/bridges/veneers, dentures, implant abutments and bars, nightguards, online case submission, doctor web portal; phone 425-822-2245. Enigma directory revenue band $1M–$5M. Sponsored PCDS April 2026 GMM. No public fee schedule found.

findings.claim: Protea Dental Studio (Redmond) is a Kois-affiliated lab run by Leon Hermanides CDT, hosts a Kois study club, and Hermanides is WSDLA Past President
findings.detail: Protea hosts the Protea Dental Kois Study Group at 15955 NE 85th St #204, Redmond (meetings 9:00–12:30; info@proteadental.com; 425-497-9428); Dr. John Kois endorses the lab. WSDLA 2026 board: President Autumn Ellingson, Past President Leon Hermanides, VP Matthew Chapman, Sec/Treas Robert Hayes. Enigma revenue band $1M–$5M.

findings.claim: PNW Pros Dental Lab (Bellevue) is owned/led by two prosthodontists who do implant surgical planning, guides and full-arch work; DOH registration DLAB.FS.61146491
findings.detail: Site says Dr. Brooks 'was the prosthodontist for a national implant company, opening their office in Bellevue' and 'has restored thousands of edentulous arches'; Dr. Johnson 35 years in prosthodontics. Address 1726 138th Place NE, Bellevue 98005; 425-698-1440. Indicates some Eastside prosthodontists are vertically integrated into their own lab.

findings.claim: Ray Dental Studio (Kent) mills custom titanium abutments in-house and offers lifetime warranty on BruxZir/Origin Live zirconia; Choice Dental Lab (Renton) runs driver pickup/delivery and full-arch zirconia; Emerald Dental Arts (Renton) mills Ti/CoCr bars
findings.detail: Ray: 431 E Ward St, Kent; 206-701-9797; also 3D-printed surgical guides. Choice: 3016 Benson Rd S, Renton; accepts STL from all scanners; NeoBiotech certified; 'Choice I-Bar' Ti-reinforced zirconia arch; 253-946-0903. Emerald: 529 Shattuck Ave S, Renton; 425-277-4779; 25+ years; 'picking up the case until delivery'. These are direct local competitors for Integra's implant and lab-to-lab milling offers.

findings.claim: Lynnwood-area labs Oasis and Seabrook offer free local pickup and delivery; Oasis charges no rush fee and covers Seattle, Bellevue and Arlington
findings.detail: Oasis Dental Lab: founded 2011, 16418 7th Pl W Ste B, Lynnwood; (425) 835-0660; all in-house; accepts all major IOS. Seabrook: 40+ years, 6101 200th St SW Ste 201, Lynnwood; 800-693-7487; free local pickup/delivery plus nationwide; prepaid USPS labels. Trosvig (Everett, 3224 Colby Ave Ste B) is a multi-technician family lab. Free courier service is a local norm Integra must match.
findings.value: free local pickup/delivery; no rush charge (Oasis)

findings.claim: VTA Dental Lab (multi-state) keeps a Renton office at 901 Rainier Ave N Ste B103 and advertises 7-day zirconia crowns; Pro-Craft (Murrieta, CA) targets WA dentists with a free iTero program and 3–5 business-day delivery
findings.detail: VTA: offices in Scottsdale, Garden Grove, Houston and Renton; '7-day zirconia crowns', first-case $150 promo, nationwide shipping. Pro-Craft: HQ 25791 Jefferson Ave, Murrieta CA (877-484-3522); claims 'most practices receiving restorations within 3–5 business days', free remakes/rush, 'perks valued at over $17,000' incl. free scanner trial; lists Seattle, Bellevue, Redmond, Kirkland, Renton among service areas.

findings.claim: Glidewell has no Washington lab; it serves WA by mail — FedEx Overnight $9 each way or free prepaid USPS Priority Mail taking 2–4 business days each way; in-office pickup for existing customers
findings.detail: Glidewell pickup-and-delivery page (2201 Dupont Dr, Irvine CA). A Dental Lab Network forum post (Oct 2023) by a user shown as 'Glidewell Dental in Kent, Washington' offered 2-day STL zirconia milling; the poster later said it was a private account and no corporate evidence of a Kent facility was found — treat as unverified.

findings.claim: National Dentex (NDX) lists no Washington or Oregon laboratory; Issaquah Dental Laboratory (640 NW Gilman Blvd, founded 1973) appears acquired/PE-backed and its former NDX page now redirects
findings.detail: NDX labs directory (accessed 2026-10-12) shows nearest labs in Danville and Sacramento CA, Provo UT, Reno NV. Enigma directory links Issaquah Dental Laboratory to nationaldentex.com/ndxissaquah/home, which now redirects to NDX Heumann Topeka; PitchBook lists status 'Acquired/Merged, PE-backed'. Current operating status in Issaquah is unknown.

findings.claim: Dandy manufactures in Lehi, UT and Carrollton, TX and has at least one Kirkland, WA practice testimonial (Smiles Dental Services); it supplies a scanner against a lab minimum
findings.detail: From Dandy site and third-party reviews surfaced in search; Dandy is a digital-only mail-order competitor present in the Eastside.

findings.claim: Pacific Dental Services supports 40 Washington offices and runs CEREC same-day crowns in-office across supported practices
findings.detail: Becker's state-by-state breakdown (~2023) gives 40 WA offices; Dentaltown (2018) says all PDS-supported offices provide CEREC CAD/CAM same-day crowns; PDS executive described buying mills and milling in-house as its chosen model. No PDS central lab network found. Removes single-unit crowns from the outsourced-lab pool.

findings.claim: Willamette Dental Group operates an in-house dental lab (digitally scanned and milled ceramic crowns, 3D-printed dentures) and has Washington offices in 18 cities including Bellevue, Everett, Kent, Mountlake Terrace, Puyallup, Seattle and Tacoma
findings.detail: Willamette services page and WA locations page. Administrative office Hillsboro, OR; lab location not stated. A closed system for lab work.

findings.claim: Light Dental Studios runs 30 Puget Sound locations (incl. Bellevue, Kent, Lynnwood, Burien, Covington, Auburn) with an in-house denture lab serving all offices; Gentle Dental 27 WA offices; Bright Now ~19 WA offices; Affordable Dentures & Implants has on-site denture labs in Tacoma and Lynnwood
findings.detail: Light Dental Studios services page (in-house denture lab for dentures, partials, relines; in-house perio/OS). Gentle Dental WA locations page (~2024). Bright Now WA office list incl. Bellevue, Issaquah. Affordable Dentures Tacoma (3801 S Steele St Ste D) and Lynnwood (2701 184th St SW Ste 118) pages/Yelp cite on-site labs. Aspen Dental WA count not found.

findings.claim: ClearChoice Metro-Seattle (1200 112th Ave NE, Bellevue) and Nuvia Bellevue each operate on-site labs and capture full-arch zirconia volume internally
findings.detail: ClearChoice: lead prosthodontists Dr. Alfonso Piñeyro and Dr. Russell Deal (UW), oral surgeons Podlosky, Lutgen, Zurayk; company states each center has a fully equipped on-site implant lab staffed by master technicians (2–3 person labs); lifetime zirconia warranty from 03/21/2025. Nuvia: 'in-house lab at every Nuvia location', permanent zirconia in 24 hours; Drs. Michael Cho and Neha Rajput (prosthodontist). ClearChoice also in Federal Way.

findings.claim: No Puget Sound lab other than Integra publishes a public fee schedule; local pricing norms must be inferred from national published lists
findings.detail: Searched Nakanishi, Protea, Shama, Seattle Dental Arts, Smile Design, Prime, PNW Pros, Choice, Oasis, Seabrook, Trosvig, Emerald, Ray, VTA, Ziemek — none post prices. United Dental Lab (Tukwila) mails a price list in its starter kit. Integra's published fees: FCZ $129, e.max $149, implant crown $269–$299, full-arch zirconia $1,700, bar+superstructure $2,200, thimble bar $2,700.

findings.claim: Published national benchmarks for monolithic zirconia crowns run $89–$122 (digital) and screw-retained zirconia implant crowns $299–$349; Integra's $129 crown sits at the upper edge of mail-order pricing
findings.detail: Crown World (Irvine CA, 2025 list): BruxZir $89 digital/$99 conventional, BruxZir Esthetic $99/$109, e.max $119–$149, screw-retained BruxZir $339, custom-abutment packages $432–$508, 3–5 day lab time. ROE (OH, 2026): zRc $93, TLZ $122, e.max $134 (3 days model-free), TLZ-SR screw-retained $299 (4 days). TrueGuide (NJ, Sept 2026): zirconia $99, Ti-base SRC $349, 5–7 business days. Ceratech boutique list: full zirconia $315–$335, SRC $625–$680.

findings.claim: Published lab-to-lab zirconia pricing is $39 (coping) to $59 (full contour) with 6-day digital turnaround; Integra's $22 mill-only is far below this benchmark
findings.detail: Mabel Dental Lab (Cuyahoga Falls, OH) January 2026 lab-to-lab list: FCZ coping $39, full contour $59, multilayer $65, Ti custom abutment $119, screw-retained full zirconia $189; full-arch zirconia $1,999 incl. up to six MUAs and two try-ins; copy-mill from approved setup $999; Ti bar hybrid $2,999. Next Dental Lab 2024: FCZ $37 (Classic) to $89 (Elite); All-on-4 zirconia with Ti bar $1,935.

findings.claim: Published full-arch zirconia final pricing ranges from $1,999 (Mabel) to $2,420 (ROE TLZ-IB) and $2,888 (ROE NobelProcera); ADL lists $3,750 for a zirconia bridge with gingival up to 5 sites
findings.detail: ROE 2026 fee schedule (TLZ-IB $2,420 at 10 days; grammetry design $287–$335); ADL 2024 schedule (milled Ti bar up to 5 sites $1,985; full-arch zirconia bridge w/ gingival $3,750); TrueGuide All-on-X from $2,999. Integra's $1,700/arch and $650 lab-to-lab arch from STL are at or below the low end.

findings.claim: Patient-facing implant fees on the Eastside: Klahanie Family Dentistry (Issaquah) lists $5,700 for a posterior implant+abutment+crown, $6,500 anterior, $12,000 for 4–6 implants under an existing denture
findings.detail: Dr. Travis Howey's published price list. Indicates the dentist-side margin over a $269–$299 lab implant crown package; useful for value-based selling.

findings.claim: Turnaround parity in this market is 5–7 business days in-lab for zirconia; Integra's five-day promise is parity, not a differentiator
findings.detail: Integra 5 business days from file receipt; VTA 7-day zirconia; Pro-Craft 3–5 business days delivered; Ziemek 5-day guided surgery; ROE/Crown World 3 days in-lab plus 2–4 days shipping each way via USPS or overnight FedEx; Mabel 6 days digital; Smile Design (Redmond) 'Guaranteed Delivery' — free if late. Patient-facing sites generally quote ~2 weeks for a lab crown.

findings.claim: How cases move: local labs use their own drivers (free pickup/delivery routes), national labs use prepaid USPS Priority or $9 FedEx Overnight, and digital cases go via 3Shape Communicate / Medit Link / iTero connections
findings.detail: Choice ('our drivers pick up cases'), Oasis, Seabrook, CBI (Port Orchard), Pacific Dental Arts (Thurston route; prepaid labels out of town); Glidewell shipping terms; Prime Dental Lab accepts iTero and 3Shape files; Nakanishi online case submission; Integra lists 3Shape/Medit/iTero/Planmeca connections.

findings.claim: Washington requires every dental lab doing business in the state to register with DOH (since Jan 31, 2021); new registrants after Jan 31, 2025 must employ a CDT working 30+ hours/week or operate under a licensed dentist; renewal fee $250
findings.detail: RCW 70.352; DOH dental laboratories FAQ; WSDLA summary. Registration number must appear on invoices and dentist work orders. Out-of-state labs serving WA dentists must also register — a compliance hurdle for mail-order competitors and for Integra's own lab-to-lab clients.

findings.claim: In-office milling is established on the Eastside: Bellevue Premier Dental (CEREC, iTero, 3D printer, CBCT), Sunrise Dental of Redmond (CEREC, '98% same-day crown delivery'), Lynnwood Dental Excellence (in-house 5-axis lab-grade mill), PDS (CEREC in all offices)
findings.detail: Bellevue Premier Dental (Dr. Nakada, 1951 152nd Pl NE #108) says its 3D printer lets it produce devices in-house 'saving the time we could have wasted engaging a third-party dental lab'. Lynnwood Dental Excellence runs its mill at an in-house lab in Federal Way for zirconia, lithium disilicate and PMMA. This caps single-unit outsourced demand among digitally advanced GPs.

findings.claim: Documented lab loyalty is long: Seattle Dental Arts 'lab of choice for over 20 years' (Dr. Linda Fukuda), Emerald Dental Arts 15 years (Dr. Isenberg), Paragon Dental Art 10 years, Pacific Dental Arts 13 years/~5,000 units from one dentist
findings.detail: Testimonials on the labs' own sites. Switching costs are relational, not contractual; most dentists describe their lab as part of the clinical team.

findings.claim: The Bel-Red corridor within ~1 mile of Integra (35 148th Ave SE) holds a cluster of prosthodontists and labs: Dr. Siamak Najafi (14645 Bel-Red Rd Ste 100), Dr. Warren Libman (14595 Bel-Red Rd Ste 100), Prime Dental Lab (14595 Bel-Red Rd), Denny Dental Lab (14420 NE Bel-Red Rd), Bellevue Dental Arts (13333 Bel-Red Rd), Bellevue Premier Dental (1951 152nd Pl NE)
findings.detail: Addresses from practice/lab sites and the Enigma directory. Proximity enables same-day shade visits, chairside support and conversions that mail-order labs cannot offer.

findings.claim: Seattle Met's 2026 peer-voted Top Dentists prosthodontics list names ~35 Puget Sound prosthodontists, including Bellevue (Russell & Michael Johnson, Warren Libman, Rosario Palacios), Mercer Island (Shiotsu), Lynnwood (Raigrodski), Federal Way (Chong; ClearChoice's Piñeyro), Puyallup (Larson), Tacoma (Phillips) and UW faculty (Ramos, Schwedhelm)
findings.detail: Seattle Met directory; useful as a vetted call list of restorative specialists who buy implant and full-arch lab work.

findings.claim: WSDA's Pacific Northwest Dental Conference 2026 runs May 28–30 at the Summit, Seattle Convention Center, with ~150 exhibitors
findings.detail: Event listings (10times, Orbital, SurgiTel). Official exhibitor list at pndc2026.eventscribe.net not fetched. Historically held at Meydenbauer Center, Bellevue.

findings.claim: Seattle Study Club is headquartered in Kirkland (9805 NE 116th St #7316; 425-576-8000), runs 250+ affiliate clubs meeting 8–10 times/year, and sells an industry partner/sponsor program; Washington affiliates include Seattle Digital Dental Hub (Dr. Rooz Khosravi), Interdisciplinary Study Group Northwest (Dr. Helena; Kois-based; Tacoma/Sumner/Auburn area) and Spokane Study Club
findings.detail: SSC contact and directory pages; SDDH and ISGNW sites. Factoria Dental Study Club (Bellevue) and Horse Creek Study Club (Bothell) appear in AGD PACE provider listings but details are unverified.

findings.claim: The Kois Center (1001 Fairview Ave N, Seattle) anchors four local Kois study groups — Western Washington Kois Study Group, MDB Kois Study Club, WACRE (full), Protea Dental Kois Study Club (Redmond) — and Kois Dentistry (Drs. John, Dean, Tara Kois) is a full-arch/implant practice
findings.detail: Kois Center study-group listing and Protea page; membership requires at least one Kois course. Kois alumni are high-value digital restorative dentists.
findings.source_date: page dated 2017-04-28 (listing may be stale); accessed 2026-10-12

findings.claim: Seattle Implant Study Club (AAID-affiliated) meets in Lynnwood (19720 68th Ave W Ste A; 425-776-9132); 2025 president Dr. Brian Baik; 47 North Oral Surgery runs a four-session, 28-CE 'Graduate Synergy Training Program' mini-residency for restorative dentists from Kirkland/Redmond/Monroe; Puget Sound Periodontics runs the South Sound Multi-Disciplinary Study Club
findings.detail: Club and practice sites. 47 North lists All-on-4 among its procedures and serves King and Snohomish counties. Puget Sound Perio (Dr. Thomas Kang; West Seattle, Federal Way, Eastlake) markets 'Teeth by Tonight' and says permanent teeth are 'created in the porcelain lab' — a surgical referral source for restorative labs.

findings.claim: Washington AGD operates a Global Learning Center in SeaTac with MasterTrack and hands-on courses (Director of Education Dr. Timothy Hess; washingtonagd.org); no Spear or ITI study club in Seattle/Bellevue/Kirkland was found
findings.detail: AGD MasterTrack directory and local-CE listings (2022–2024 dated). Spear Education is Scottsdale-based; Frank Spear and Greggory Kinzer (Spear Aesthetics, 720 Olive Way, Seattle) practice(d) in Seattle. ITI lists study clubs globally but none surfaced for Puget Sound.

findings.claim: UW School of Dentistry is a digital-prosthodontics channel: Graduate Prosthodontics (Interim Director Dr. John Sorensen, ex-ClearChoice Portland, B4T research lab pursuing a fully digital All-on-4 workflow; lab technician Kleve Hansen; residents print models and use sintering ovens) and a CDE program with ceramics/full-arch webinars in Nov 2026
findings.detail: UW Graduate Prosthodontics page and CDE schedule (Nov 18, 2026 'From Single Implants to Full-Arch Cases'; Nov 13 'All-Ceramic Dentistry Cookbook'). Former Grad Pros director Dr. Ariel Raigrodski now practices in Lynnwood with TRIOS and CBCT. UW's 2015 'Implant Systems Study Club' appears dormant.

findings.claim: Eastside practices naming their scanners: Kirkland Premier Dentistry (iTero, CBCT; prosthodontist + oral surgeon in-house), Issaquah Premier Dental (Primescan, Primescan 2, iTero Lumina), Bellevue Dental Arts (iTero Lumina Pro), Redmond DDS (Primescan), Smiles By Design Kirkland (TRIOS), ARID Northwest Lynnwood (TRIOS), Blooming Dental Lynnwood/Des Moines (iTero, CBCT, guided surgery)
findings.detail: Practice technology pages. These are digital-ready accounts that can send files directly; several also do same-day crowns, so the opportunity is implant, esthetic and full-arch work rather than routine posterior crowns.

findings.claim: Smile Design Dental Lab (Redmond) offers 'Guaranteed Delivery' (case free if delivered after the patient appointment) and references 'a big blow' to Washington dental services on its site
findings.detail: Lab site, 2045 152nd Ave NE, Redmond; 425-653-1294; products include Origin zirconia, e.max, Lava, digital implant restorations. The nature of the 'big blow' (likely a payer/reimbursement change) was not readable from the fetched text.

findings.claim: Ziemek Dental Lab (Olympia HQ, 2310 Mottman Rd SW) runs its own milling center, lists 11 implant systems, 5-day guided-surgery turnaround, fixed hybrids in zirconia/Ti, and ships nationally (testimonial from Maryland)
findings.detail: Ziemek products and contact pages; serves Tacoma/Pierce dentists (testimonial from Dr. Steve Marinkovich, Tacoma). A South Sound competitor with in-house milling capacity similar to Integra's.

findings.claim: Historical context: King County had 109 licensed dentists per 100,000 in 2016 (UW 2017 report); the state had 6,325 dentist licenses in 2016 and 5,819 in 2009
findings.detail: Patterson et al., UW CHWS, Nov 2017; UW workforce page. Shows steady growth of ~1–1.5%/yr in licensed dentists statewide.

unknowns: Exact count of DOH-registered dental laboratories in King, Snohomish and Pierce counties — the DOH Provider Credential/Facility Search (Facility Type: Dental Laboratory Registration) is interactive and could not be queried; no published total was found.

Census County Business Patterns establishment/employment counts for NAICS 339116 (dental laboratories) and 621210 (offices of dentists) by county — the Census API returned 'Missing Key'; BLS QCEW CSV endpoints were blocked by content type. Without these, no lab-to-dentist ratio versus a national baseline can be stated.
Snohomish County-specific dentist ratio (only the five-county North Sound ACH figure of 62/100k is published); exact licensed dentist counts by county (UW tableau 'County Trends' not fetchable).
Pierce County Dental Society membership and penetration — its own site says >385 members (~55%), LinkedIn says >430 (~80%); neither is dated.
Whether Issaquah Dental Laboratory (640 NW Gilman Blvd) still operates and under whose ownership (PitchBook: acquired/PE-backed; former NDX page redirects).
Whether Glidewell has any milling or pickup presence in Kent, WA (a 2023 forum post claimed so; no corporate evidence).

Actual fee schedules and turnaround commitments of local labs (Nakanishi, Protea, Shama, Seattle Dental Arts, Smile Design, Prime, PNW Pros, Choice, Oasis, Seabrook, Trosvig, Emerald, Ray, Ziemek) — none publish prices; United Dental Lab mails one in its starter kit.
Which labs the named Eastside prosthodontists and full-arch practices currently use, and whether Washington State Prosthodontics (Drs. Johnson) routes work to the affiliated PNW Pros lab.
Aspen Dental and Heartland Dental office counts in Washington; whether Gentle Dental (InterDent) or Bright Now use centralized labs.
Cost of exhibiting at PNDC 2026, sponsoring SKCDS/SCDS/PCDS general membership meetings, or joining Seattle Study Club's partner program (no public rate cards found).
Current status of Seattle-area Spear or ITI study clubs (none found) and of UW's Implant Systems Study Club (last evidence 2015).
Any evidence of dentist dissatisfaction with existing local labs — none was found; claims of unmet need would be speculation.
